project.name: Return (941) SEO/AIO Optimization
project.description: SEO and AI Optimization improvements for 941return.com meditation timer app

stories.title: Create llms.txt and llms-full.txt files
stories.description: Implement llms.txt files for AI discoverability per llmstxt.org specification
acceptance_criteria: Create /llms.txt with app summary and key features
Create /llms-full.txt with detailed documentation
Include: meditation features, timer modes, HealthKit integration
Add blog content summary and topics
Serve with text/plain content type
Add routes in FastAPI

stories.title: Add featured images to blog posts
stories.description: Create and add featured/OG images for all 250 blog posts to improve social sharing
acceptance_criteria: Create template for generating blog OG images
Generate images for top 50 highest-traffic posts first
Add og:image meta tags to blog post template
Ensure images are 1200x630 for optimal social display
Add twitter:image meta tags

stories.title: Implement HowTo schema for meditation guides
stories.description: Add HowTo structured data to meditation technique posts
acceptance_criteria: Identify blog posts with step-by-step instructions
Add HowTo JSON-LD schema to those posts
Include estimated time and difficulty level
Validate with Rich Results Test
Target 'how to meditate' type queries

stories.title: Add FAQPage schema to support/FAQ page
stories.description: Implement FAQPage structured data for common questions
acceptance_criteria: Create or enhance FAQ section on site
Add FAQPage JSON-LD schema
Include questions about: HealthKit sync, timer features, Apple Watch
Validate schema with Rich Results Test

stories.title: Add Key Takeaways to all blog posts
stories.description: Add TL;DR/Key Takeaways sections to blog posts for AI parsing
acceptance_criteria: Update blog post template with Key Takeaways section
Add takeaways to top 25 posts first
Use structured semantic HTML (ul/li)
Include 3-5 actionable takeaways per post

stories.title: Optimize video content for SEO
stories.description: Add VideoObject schema and optimize video embeds
acceptance_criteria: Identify pages with embedded videos
Add VideoObject JSON-LD schema
Include thumbnail, duration, upload date
Add video sitemap entries

stories.title: Implement author schema for blog posts
stories.description: Add Person schema for blog authors to establish expertise
acceptance_criteria: Add author information to blog posts
Implement Person JSON-LD schema
Link to author social profiles
Add author bio sections
